summary: Examples of include_tasks: including a file, a templated file name with a condition, and applying tags to included tasks with both file and free-form syntax.
questions: How do I include a task file named after a variable?
How do I apply tags to included tasks using free-form syntax?
Why do I need tags: always on include_tasks with apply?

answer_card.title: include_tasks examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: {file: stuff.yaml}
- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: "{{ hostvar }}.yaml"
  when: hostvar is defined
- ansible.builtin.include_tasks:
    file: install.yml
    apply:
      tags: [install]
  tags: [always]
# free-form:
- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: install.yml
  args:
    apply: {tags: [install]}
  tags: [always]
```
`tags: always` ensures the include runs so inner tags can be selected.
